mismatches.description: Potential contract contradiction: control_plane_validity requires exactly_one_current_evidence_record_per_required_check, while not_started_predicate requires current_evidence_set_exists=false and no rerun queue. Because control_plane_invalid is evaluated before NOT_STARTED, a strict evaluator that applies the evidence-cardinality assertion universally will derive HOLD before NOT_STARTED can be reached.
mismatches.recommended_resolution: Scope exactly_one_current_evidence_record_per_required_check to products whose current_evidence_set_exists=true, or explicitly exempt lifecycle_state=PLANNED products with no evidence/queue from that control-plane assertion. Preserve control-plane-invalid precedence for every other case.
